notes.title: General Update Type Stuff or Something?
notes.content:
Hey there! 

This is the first ever announcement/update I've made to Steam in the 7 months since the HH page has been made public (I should've probably made more by now - oops). Anyway, I just wanted to make a short post with a few updates about the game's development:


Mizushi's 3rd Act is now the final act that needs to be written - after that, all that needs to be done in terms of writing is editing, clean-up, re-writing, etc.
Assets like art, music, UI, and especially voice acting, have been steadily produced over the past couple of months and some facets are almost completely finished, like the chibi art and alt costumes.
And, most excitingly of all (and despite my better judgments and lack of proper funds) I've greenlit some fun (and FREE!) post-game content! I'll give more details as to what this will be later down the line!

So, yeah, quick update, but I just wanted to let you all know how things are going and finally post something here on Steam! Thank you all so much for showing interest in the game, wishlisting, following, yadda, yadda, yadda - it really means a lot to me, and motivates me like nothing else to make this game as good as I can make it!

Please, if you have any questions about anything (not literally anything, like doorknobs and geckos or something), feel free to comment here or DM the HH Twitter account: @HybridHarmonyVN.

- Cyberwaste (Lead dev guy)
